nodes.label: Analisis: RAG en handyman - estado del arte y opciones
Agentic Search over RAG for Harness State
nodes.rationale: The harness corpus is small, structured and constantly changing - exactly where grep/read agentic search wins and a vector index goes stale; Anthropic removed vector search from Claude Code for the same reason. Recommendation: no RAG pipeline for handyman.

nodes.label: Backlog Deduplication (cheap candidates + LLM judge)
nodes.rationale: The only case with clear embedding ROI: paraphrased duplicates where BM25 fails; design is top-k vector + top-k BM25 fused with RRF, verdict by a cheap LLM judge; below ~500 items BM25 + judge alone suffices.
